thread:
ashley: CI turned red on allocator_test (flaky hang) — seen 2/5 runs fail with a hang in TestRetryWindow under stress. job: https://ci.internal/37384 (job 37384). stack snippet shows worker stuck in backoff loop.

mike: can you paste the failing log snippet? is it deterministic w/ a seed?

ashley: log here (trimmed):
```
E 12:34:56 allocator.go:412 retry window overlapped, enter backoff
W 12:34:59 worker.go:128 stalled waiting for kv cache
... (no progress for 90s)
```
Not seeing a seed in the test harness. Repro rate local: ~1/10 with stress profile.

tim: ugh. Could be timing + race between prefetch and retry window. Do we have the flaky tag on that test? If not, we should rerun with varying seeds and capture traces.

ashley: not tagged. Requesting quick reruns now. CI job id 37384 has the artifacts, but rerun endpoint didn't capture the per-test trace. Can someone trigger a rerun with env TEST_SEED sweep and longer debug timeout? e.g.

mike: I can kick a sweep. Command I'll run:
```
ci-trigger --job allocator_test --sweep-seeds 1000-1009 --debug-timeout=300s --collect-trace
```
Will post results here in ~20m.

sara: if it's a prefetch vs retry ordering issue, enabling PREFETCH_LOG=1 helps. Also try `--run-smoke` vs `--stress` to narrow.

ci-bot: rerun queued by mike for job allocator_test (parent 37384). sweep seeds 1000-1009. expected finish ~20m.

ashley: thanks. If one seed reproduces reliably we should bisect commit range. Current suspicion: recent change to backoff jitter in PR #2024 by @jorge.

tim: quick triage plan: 1) get seed that reproduces 2) if stable, run git-bisect building/testrunner to find offending commit 3) add deterministic timeout/guard in allocator to avoid hard hang 4) mark test flaky and add triage note.

mike: first two seeds ran: seed 1003 hung (trace uploaded) and seed 1007 passed. 1003 trace: https://ci.internal/artifacts/37384/1003/trace.json

ashley: opening a bisect task now. Assign to tim to run the bisect? tagging @tim

tim: I'll take bisect. If it's the jitter tweak that's my PR queue to inspect. Will update here when bisect hits a culprit. :thumbsup:

mike: FYI I added a temporary CI step to collect a goroutine dump on test stall (stackdump on 60s of no progress). Should help for future flakes.

sara: nice. Also suggest adding a small unit test that simulates concurrent prefetch+retry with injected sleeps.

ashley: agreed. I'll draft the test after we get the bisect result. Thanks all.
